FFprobe WebP/1024x768 structure, complete FFmpeg decode, and SSIM at least 0.90
FFprobe H.264/AAC structure and duration, exact source/output H.264 and AAC packet hashes, and complete FFmpeg decode

additionalPerBrowser: normal-page CSV-to-TSV conversion through the real user-selected direct destination writer
unsafe TAR path-traversal rejection with no partial OPFS output
all observed conversion requests are same-origin GET with no bodies, filenames, or fixture-content tokens
functional Wasm/SIMD, workers, File System Access, OPFS, SharedArrayBuffer/isolation, Web Crypto, OffscreenCanvas, image decoder, and WebCodecs probes
zero page errors, console errors, or failed same-origin requests

opera.finding: standard Opera 135.0.5973.92 was the published stable line; standard Opera was not installed, so no standard-Opera result is claimed from the installed Opera GX 134 build

headedReview.result: the real completed MKV-to-MP4 state, progress/output metrics, privacy indicator, controls, and generated registry rendered without overlap or clipping; no console or page errors occurred

limitations: This is representative cross-browser functional coverage, not a claim that every one of the 388 public profiles ran in every browser.
Complete process-tree private-memory and multi-gigabyte stress evidence remains explicitly Chrome-only.
The standard Opera distribution was unavailable; Opera GX is named exactly and is not generalized to standard Opera.
Opera GX headed automation was not claimed because its singleton startup behavior could not be isolated without disrupting the user's existing browser session.
scope: U-05 is verified for every installed and practically testable target: broad representative production conversions and failure/privacy/cleanup behavior pass in Chrome, Edge, Brave, and Opera GX, with exact browser limitations disclosed. This evidence does not replace route-wide Chrome correctness or complete-process memory certification.
